reviewer: Claude research agent; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the HyCell batch (issue #234) by a different agent from the extractor, against the extraction frozen at commit 750a1af94e5bfc0d9aa5a374f15094f2c2efbe6b. The branch's base was then corrected by the coordinator's merge dc0309a, which replaced a superseded HyInv state with the reviewed one; every check reported here that touches the store was run against that merged base. The batch holds 560 records: 8 sources, 5 models, 1 method, 14 configurations, 1 benchmark, 8 datasets, 16 protocols, 223 evaluations, 223 results and 61 claims, plus three concepts added to data/vocab/metric.ttl. All nine pinned artifacts were re-downloaded at commit 0dcc533cc9f8f76c90ecbfe944df816b6672328a and their SHA-256 checked against the source records, including the 64,439,816-byte weights, whose hash also equals the weights_sha256 published in the checkpoint sidecar; the seven archived copies in artifacts/ are byte-identical to the fresh downloads, and pdftotext -layout on the re-downloaded PDF reproduced the archived text layer byte for byte. npm run batch -- check-values was rerun over the whole batch and reproduced the extractor's value-check.tsv exactly before the review's locator corrections (60 in_cell, 96 in_row, 67 locator_not_parsed; no not_in_row, wrong_column or overclaimed_in_row), and gives 72 in_cell, 84 in_row, 67 locator_not_parsed after them. All 198 results in Tables 3, 4 and 5 and in Figure 1b were then re-read by column position by review/cell-check.py, written for this pass without using the extractor's parser: it finds each table by its own printed header line, indexes the cell by column, and matched every printed value (review/cell-check.tsv). Figure 1b's column identity was fixed two independent ways, by the Mean row against Table 3's Bio column and by the rotated headers as pdftotext -raw prints them. Thirty-six arithmetic identities were recomputed and all hold. The 25 prose results were checked by hand against the sentence each locator names and against the system each number belongs to (review/prose-check.py). Each of the 61 claims was re-read against the passage its locator names. The review's rulings and corrections were applied by review/apply-review.py; the batch then passes the dry run of the records -- add checks against the 87,787 stored records.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude research agent, independent of the extractor but not human scientific review. Transcription was checked against the pinned source; nothing was reproduced and no value was recomputed.

npm run batch -- check-values cannot parse a figure or prose locator and cannot name Table 4's columns, so 151 of the 223 results are not placed in a cell by the tool. They rest on the reviewer's own column-position parse of the text layer, which covers all 198 table and figure cells, and on the hand check of the 25 prose values.

Figure 1b is read from the PDF text layer, not from the rendered page. Its column identity rests on the Mean row matching Table 3's Bio column for exactly one assignment of six models and on the headers pdftotext -raw prints; the rendered page was not inspected.
No uncertainty is printed anywhere in the report, so no result carries one and the 0.735 against 0.736 comparison cannot be tested.

The seven atlases are stated to be excluded from HyCell's pretraining corpus only. The report does not say whether the ten published comparators were pretrained on cells of these atlases, so the comparison is not shown to be held out for them. Recorded as a limitation on the benchmark, the report source and the eleven protocols that score the comparators, not as an evidence concern.

The checkpoint's identity is verified from its bytes, but the model was not run and no embedding was recomputed, so the report's claim that the package reproduces the scored embeddings bit for bit was not tested.

Discrepancies were not checked against a built discrepancies.json: the batch is not in the store, so none of its result IDs can appear in an existing discrepancy. The check belongs to the knowledge-graph build after the batch is added.
